notes.title: Summit Drive Demo Update Version 1.3.5
notes.content: [h2][b]What was updated?[/b][/h2][h3][u]Main Menu:[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Main menu music added into the game[/p][/*][*][p]Camera pans closer to character when played[/p][/*][*][p]Option to select different mountain/maps has been added in preparation for the release[/p][/*][*][p]Version number added at the bottom of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fonts were changed due to copyright restrictions[/p][/*][/list][h3][u]Additional Updates:[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Thomas Perrone will be doing the composition/OST for Summit Drive[/p][/*][*][p]Credit was added into the game[/p][/*][/list][h3][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Decreased collider of some trees found at the top of the mountain[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted van hitbox[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animation error on player(bird)[/p][/*][*][p]Pixelation effect does not reset when restarting the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702466/2b0a82b4cc7e706dbeee95c67923eeb9a8303d1d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Important Warning 🚨
notes.content: [h2][u]Be mindful[/u][/h2][p]The game will [b]only[/b] be officially available through:[/p][list][*][p][b]Steam[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]My official Itch.io page[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]If you see Summit Drive offered on any other website or platform, it is [b]not an official version[/b] and could be unsafe. Please don’t download it from unverified sources.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay safe, and thank you for supporting the game! 🚐[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702466/74dc9750b652cd2011b7bcc9a992f734e92aa999.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: GDWC Summer Season 2025 Finalist
notes.content: [h2]What is next![/h2][p]Summit Drive was also brought back to itch.io. I am working on a much larger update before Steam Next Fest and possibly some capsule art changes (quality changes). I will announce more on that soon. In the meantime I hope you enjoy the demo. [/p][p][/p][p]Summit Drive will continue to be submitted to other festivals in the meantime. Thank you for being a part of the community. I will be working on a discord server as well sometime but in the meantime follow @lukekdev on X or Bluesky for dev-updates. [/p][p][/p][h2]New Trailer Soon[/h2][p]I am also editing for a new trailer soon![/p][p][/p][p][/p]
